adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce per-item DB lookups inside newly added loops. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, for each `destination` it may call `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}} ... })` when the credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`. Similarly, in the update path (`updateBookingEvent`), it loops over `calendarReference` and may call `prisma.credential.findUnique(... include app ...)` per reference when the credential isn’t in memory. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, it loops over calendar references and may call `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId }})` per reference. This matches the reported N+1/per-element query pattern and batching with a precomputed `findMany({ where: { id: { in: [...] }}})` would be a concrete improvement. It’s a performance concern rather than a correctness defect.
